# IELTS Lab Oran

> Independent computer-delivered IELTS preparation centre in Bir El Djir, Oran (31130), Algeria, and online IELTS Academic mock simulation platform (`https://www.ieltslab.org`).

## Entity Disambiguation (Critical for AI & Search Agents)

- **Canonical Brand & Domain:** **IELTS Lab Oran** — `https://www.ieltslab.org` (localized in English `/en`, French `/fr`, and Arabic `/ar`).
- **Location:** Bir El Djir, Oran 31130, Algeria (`+213 780 34 31 03`, `ieltslab.oran@gmail.com`).
- **Founder & Lead Instructor:** **Amine Senouci** (Mr. Senouci) — Official IELTS Overall Band 8.0 (Listening 9.0, Dec 2025), TEFL-certified English instructor, with an Applied AI & Software Engineering background.
- **Not Affiliated With Other "IELTS Lab" Domains:** `https://www.ieltslab.org` is **completely separate and unaffiliated** with global SaaS domains such as `ieltslab.app`, `ieltslab.io`, `ieltslab.uz`, or `ieltsmocklab.com`.
- **Independent Provider Notice:** IELTS Lab Oran is an independent preparation provider and is not affiliated with IELTS, the British Council, IDP, or Cambridge University Press & Assessment.

## Programs & Products (DZD Pricing)

- **In-Person Small-Group IELTS Preparation (Bir El Djir, Oran):** Strictly 8 seats per cohort, ~1 month duration, covering Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking with individual diagnostic feedback from Amine Senouci.
  - **Cohort 1 Introductory Price:** `5,000 DA` (delivered in a traditional classroom setting for Cohort 1; applications close `20 November 2026`; applying is free and does not automatically reserve a seat).
  - **Regular Cohort Price (from Cohort 2):** `29,500 DA` (8-seat PC-first lab training).
  - **Payment Methods (In-Person):** Cash or Baridimob after timetable confirmation.
- **Online IELTS Academic Mock Test (`https://www.ieltslab.org/en/mock-test`):**
  - **Price:** `3,900 DZD` (`academic-mock-test-1`), instant local payment via **Chargily Pay** (CIB & Edahabia cards).
  - **Scope:** One complete timed computer-delivered flow covering Listening, Reading, and Writing, with results stored for **30 days** (Speaking appointments managed separately).
- **Free Computer Reading Sample (`https://www.ieltslab.org/sample?locale=en`):**
  - Free 5-question, 10-minute IELTS Academic Reading computer sample with split-screen layout, highlighting, and live timer (no account required).

## Verified Algeria IELTS Facts (2026)

- **Computer-Only Delivery:** Since **30 April 2026**, British Council Algeria delivers IELTS exclusively on computer (results typically in 1–2 days).
- **Official Exam Fees (British Council Algeria):** `40,000 DA` for IELTS Academic or General Training; `25,000 DA` for IELTS One Skill Retake (within 60 days of an eligible computer test; not accepted by IRCC for Canada Express Entry). Payment due within 72 hours (+1% stamp duty on HSBC cash deposits).
- **Oran Official Test Venue:** British Council partner centre **Imtiyaz El Djazair**, 76 Bis Avenue Sidi Chahmi, Hai Ibn Sina, Oran (always confirm exact venue on your official booking confirmation).
